name: House in the Woods
storyline:
Ian and Sophie head to the former home of the O'Connels, who were brutally murdered years ago. The suspect was never found. Sophie is hoping that the house will be scary enough to make a disturbing video for her social media. Of course, the video will be staged. Instead of recording their first reaction to entering the house, Sophie decides to thoroughly inspect the place in order to plan the most dramatic video possible.

You play as Ian, who is tasked with exploring the house, and ideally finding spooky things to add to the video. While Sophie expects him to find weird photos, creepy dolls, or any unintentionally scary everyday items, Ian happens to stumble across secret areas of the house. And what he finds inside is truly disturbing.
summary: A short RPG Maker horror game about exploring an abandoned house.
